# secureaccess_access_policy_settings (Resource)

This resource manages Access Policy Rule Defaults and Global Settings.
 On destroy, setting values are preserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_access_policy_settings" "example" {
  zero_trust_access_authentication         = true
  zero_trust_access_authentication_timeout = 485
  editing_session_duration                 = 55
  editing_session_extension                = 6
  global_ips_profile_id                    = "654321"
  microsoft_365_compatibility              = true
  decryption_global                        = true
  decryption_disable_for_sources           = ["10.10.0.0/24"]
  log_decrypted_internet_destinations      = true
  log_decrypted_private_resources          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `decryption_disable_for_sources` (List of String) List of sources for which decryption is disabled. Accepted formats include IP addresses and CIDR blocks.
- `decryption_global` (Boolean) Enable or disable global IPS.
- `editing_session_duration` (Number) How long an editing session lasts before it automatically expires.
  - Range: `1`-`60`
- `editing_session_extension` (Number) Allow admins to extend their editing session once it's close to expiring. (minutes per extension)
  - Range: `0`-`15`
- `global_ips_profile_id` (String) Set the IPS posture profile ID.
- `log_decrypted_internet_destinations` (Boolean) Log decrypted traffic to internet destinations.
- `log_decrypted_private_resources` (Boolean) Log decrypted traffic to private resources.
- `microsoft_365_compatibility` (Boolean) Enable or disable Microsoft 365 compatibility.
- `zero_trust_access_authentication` (Boolean) Enable ZTA authentication timeout.
- `zero_trust_access_authentication_timeout` (Number) Set the ZTA authentication timeout in minutes.
  - Range: `1`-`43200`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
